title: Cross-stage kernel elector and stability quilt for prefill-decode benchmarks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Our current CI benchmark suite treats prefill and decode phases as independent runs for perf gating, which obscures interactions when the kernel selection logic switches between stage-optimized kernels (e.g., prefill-friendly vs. decode-friendly). This leads to intermittent regressions in tail latency when new kernel heuristics or attention micro-optimizations land. Goal: Build a cross-stage benchmarking harness and canonical stability artifacts ('stability quilt') that exercise realistic transitions between prefill and decode, drive the kernel elector under representative traffic, and produce deterministic signals for CI perf gates. The harness should: 1) synthesize hybrid traces that include warm prefixes, cache reuse, and variable decode lengths; 2) run kernel-election stress scenarios (rapid context-length changes, mixed batch shapes) to surface oscillations; 3) capture quantile latency and allocation deltas per kernel candidate; 4) output a compact lockfile/golden quilt that CI can diff to detect meaningful regressions. Scope: engine-side harness, CI integration, telemetry schema, and a small dashboard for visualizing kernel ballot churn. Out of scope: rewriting kernel implementations (we only exercise them).
acceptance_criteria: Hybrid-prefill/decode synthetic trace generator that can reproduce at least 3 recorded production transition patterns
CI job that runs the cross-stage harness in nightly and posts a diffable stability quilt artifact
Perf gate rules that flag >5% regression in P95 or >10% regression in P99 for affected kernels
A kernel-elector telemetry export (per-run kernel ballots, latency percentiles, KV cache hit rate) recorded to the benchmark bucket
Dashboard panel showing kernel-churn heatmap and a time series for stability quilt diffs
tasks: Design trace templates for hybrid prefill->decode transitions (Asha)
Implement synthetic trace runner and recorder (Luca)
Instrument kernel-elector to emit per-stage ballot events and decision rationale (Eng: runtime-team)
Define stability-quilt serialization and compare tool for CI (Eng + SRE)
Create CI job and perf-gate rulebook; add alerting for flaky diffs (SRE)
Build simple dashboard and link to nightly artifacts (Observability)
Run a 2-week goldenization: produce baseline quilt and run noise analysis
decisions: Run harness in two modes: deterministic locked-seed (CI) and fuzzed stochastic (perf investigations). Deterministic chosen for gates to avoid flakes.
Represent stability artifact as a small protobuf-encoded artifact with per-cohort statistics rather than raw traces to keep CI artifacts small.
Begin with existing workload corpus plus three new transition templates; evaluate expanding corpus after initial run.
We will adopt percentile-based regression rules rather than mean token cost to better protect tail-sensitive SLAs.
